working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF) cluster named 'R7.8' by the authors (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, GSE156455 metadata_early subtype); composed primarily of immature R7/R8 photoreceptor cells of the developing optic lobe/eye.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron of the eye disc that will develop into one of the photoreceptors (R1-R8) of the adult eye.

justification: Authors group R7 and R8 (inner photoreceptors) in the early data. FBbt has photoreceptor R7 precursor cell (FBbt:00048009) and R8 precursor cell (FBbt:00048010) but no combined inner-photoreceptor immature term; the general eye photoreceptor precursor cell is the common parent. Stage fit (eye disc precursor vs 0-24h APF) is approximate.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron of the eye disc that will develop into a photoreceptor cell R7 of the adult eye.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only R7; cluster groups R7 and R8.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron of the eye disc that will develop into a photoreceptor cell R8 of the adult eye.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only R8; cluster groups R7 and R8.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Eye photoreceptor cell whose rhabdomere is located in the center of each ommatidium.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature inner photoreceptor; cells are developing (0-24h APF).

recommendation: Broad match to eye photoreceptor precursor cell; low confidence due to stage mismatch.
